rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty about hatching status, TE cohesion, and zona thinning/herniation from this single image where TE detail is limited.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, prior cycle history, and sperm data with embryo quality well, though it somewhat overinterprets prior outcomes as implantation failure phenotype and questions male factor without full semen context.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include speculative deductions and somewhat arbitrary percentage adjustments.

Largely aligned with standard IVF practice, including recognition of strong blastocyst morphology and support for single embryo transfer; slight deviation comes from speculative RIF/immunologic framing without sufficient basis.
Provides at least one practical recommendation (proceed with eSET), but the recommendations shown are incomplete/truncated and lack fuller concrete transfer and future-cycle planning details.
